content: A score of 5 or higher on the American Diabetes Association (ADA) risk assessment indicates an elevated likelihood of developing type 2 diabetes. Individuals with this score are advised to seek medical consultation for additional diagnostic testing to confirm or rule out the condition. The risk of type 2 diabetes is disproportionately higher among certain ethnic and racial groups, including African Americans, Hispanic/Latino individuals, Native Americans, Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders. Additionally, individuals with higher body weight are at an increased risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
